name: Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location, before taxes. Students and educators can schedule through Certiport.

exam.format: Proctored 45-minute exam through Pearson VUE (Certiport for students and educators); interactive components may appear. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

scope: Core data concepts, relational and non-relational data on Azure, and analytics workloads on Azure.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for DP-900.
